context.audience: Client security owner, ORG deployer, ORG reviewer

blocks.text: This form records a single deviation from the connector deployment runbook for the approved pilot engagement, including client, tenant, originating runbook and version, and the section deviated from.
This deviation is not yet approved for distribution outside the review chain.
A Graph scope broader than the approved use case requires is granted to support a defined reporting workflow for a named group over a fixed period.
The broader scope increases the data reachable by the connector for the named group; the affected roles, regulatory obligations, and any audit or discoverability gaps are recorded.

items: Access restricted to the named group by Entra app assignment.
Anomaly monitoring stood up with a baseline before go-live.
Users notified and retrained on the narrowed use case.

blocks.text: The deviation takes effect on the recorded date, expires at a fixed review date, and is reassessed on any qualifying trigger; the disposition at review is to extend, narrow, or withdraw.
Signed before implementation by the ORG deployer, the ORG reviewer, and the client designated security owner; retroactive sign-off is not permitted.
